route_guardian_loader.label: PMP Current Route Guardian Loader v14

current_app.label: PMP Current v15 with true same-shell Move Ledger candidate panel

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Current v15 keeps Recovery Tools v8 as emergency recovery only and removes Recovery Tools v9 from the normal path. It adds a true same-shell Move Ledger button inside Route Guardian Last Good using pmp-same-shell-move-ledger-lite-v1.js. Move targets open inside the app shell with a collapsible candidate panel, Go Back returns to the same-shell Move Ledger screen, and Make This Version Current only saves a Route Guardian make-current request. Packet 1.5, free-only gates, Safe Writer, Dashboard, and the core app shell are unchanged.
